text: That night. <break time="0.8s" /> Scrooge saw Marleys face. <break time="0.8s" /> In the knocker on his front door. <break time="0.8s" /> He looked again. <break time="0.8s" /> But it was only a knocker. <break time="0.8s" /> So he went inside. <break time="0.8s" /> Later as he sat by his small fire. <break time="0.8s" /> He heard a loud clanking noise. <break time="0.8s" /> Then Marleys ghost came straight. <break time="0.8s" /> Through the heavy door. <break time="0.8s" /> Which was still locked. <break time="0.8s" /> The ghost dragged a long chain. <break time="0.8s" /> That was made of cash boxes, keys, and heavy purses. <break time="0.8s" /> I wear the chain. <break time="0.8s" /> I forged in life. <break time="0.8s" /> Said the ghost. <break time="0.8s" /> I made it link by link. <break time="0.8s" /> Because I cared only about money. <break time="0.8s" /> But you were always a good man of business. <break time="0.8s" /> Jacob said Scrooge. <break time="0.8s" /> Mankind was my business. <break time="0.8s" /> Cried the ghost. <break time="0.8s" /> Wringing its hands. <break time="0.8s" /> Marley warned that Scrooges own chain. <break time="0.8s" /> Was even longer and heavier than his. <break time="0.8s" /> Three Spirits will visit you. <break time="0.8s" /> He said. <break time="0.8s" /> They are your only hope. <break time="0.8s" /> Then the ghost floated out. <break time="0.8s" /> Through the window. <break time="0.8s" /> And Scrooge fell asleep at once.
